title: Skates at the Lake
summary: Judy has found her old rollerblades, they do not fit, and she is going to play street hockey at the Laguna Bend boat ramp anyway.

start.bringUp: Judy has found her old rollerblades and is going to play street hockey by the Laguna Bend boat ramp with a can and two crates. Bring up, in your own way, that you want V to come and kick the can with her.

boat-ramp.name: the empty car park by the Laguna Bend boat ramp

JH4.invite.01.text: Found my old rollerblades. They don't fit. I'm going anyway.

g1.asks: Were you a sports kid or a fighting kid?
g1.know: The shoot-out so far, the can and the two crates used as a goal.

stages.label: Judy and V play a shoot-out at the Laguna Bend boat ramp
stages.know: Judy cannot skate, so you are playing street hockey by the boat ramp. You kick a can into a goal made of two crates while she counts your kicks and laughs at her own commentary.
stages.wants: V to take shots with her at the crates.

played.memory: You played street hockey with Judy at the Laguna Bend boat ramp, with no skates and a can for a puck.

left.memory: You left Judy at the Laguna Bend boat ramp before the shoot-out was over.

variations.know: Dusk over the car park, and the light is going while you play.
variations.wants: V's shots in the failing light.

variations.know: Rain on the car park, and the can keeps sliding away from both of you.
Two local kids have turned up and want to play too, and Judy is pretending she does not mind.
